description: DEP-05 §Cosignature Threshold and DEP-06 §Race, a rotation past quorum_expiry. 'rung_sign': the same opt-out for the rotation's rungs, judged at the QuorumBegin's block height against the SPENT vault's quorum expiry; new_quorum_expiry never matters (REVIEW 11) (ruled 2026-11-14: "we can allow it, but we can't require members to sign"). 'cosign': whether a member signs an op of the given class at block_height; before quorum_expiry always, at or past it only an establishment op (QuorumAddMember, QuorumRemoveMember, QuorumBegin), and that only by the member's own policy (cosign_post_expiry). Refusing is never a fault. 'outcome': what a member does with its own quorum_expired dispute: a QuorumBegin after the dispute's fork point (reestablished) ends it, armed or not: the member yields (DisputeYield) and its pledge lapses with no lottery; a confiscation that confirmed first decides the race, and the dispute runs on.

cosign.name: before expiry, a QuorumBegin, policy refuses: the policy only speaks past expiry
at expiry, a transfer (signet soak 2026-11-14, ledger L seq 284026)
past expiry, a QuorumBegin, default policy (signet soak 2026-11-14: ledger J re-established at 5885)
past expiry, a QuorumAddMember, member declines
deep in Tier 2, a QuorumBegin, default policy

outcome.name: re-established, armed: yield, the arm's pledge lapses
re-established, never armed: yield too (signet soak 2026-11-14: three reference disputes on J left open)
re-established after the confiscation confirmed: the chain decided, the dispute runs on

rung_sign.name: QuorumBegin before the spent vault's expiry, member opted out: the policy only speaks past expiry
QuorumBegin past the spent vault's expiry, default policy
QuorumBegin past the spent vault's expiry, member opted out: refused, though the new quorum's expiry is far ahead (REVIEW 11)
